design_intent: stacked two-deck ship with ramp up and elevator down; template C

fire_zones.rationale: non-critical side link to optional loot room (objective 1); fire cannot trap the player or block any main objective

arc_zones.rationale: non-critical side link to the optional portable oxygen pump pickup room; arc cannot trap the player or block any main objective

breach_zones.rationale: obj4-to-obj5 traversal corridor; sealed when main power is restored (sequence 2)
